name: Fan Edit Optimus
tagline: Hunts down fan edits of films and series across community edit archives
description: Name a film or series and it goes looking for fan-made cuts of it, searching a long-running community Drive archive, the fan-edit corners of Reddit, and a hand-picked list of edit sites. Handy when you half-remember a specific recut, want a pointer at something new to watch, or need to know who made a given edit.
author: FanEditFanClub
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
